_comment: Rough, general-purpose AR/VR performance guidance — NOT official ReactVision/platform-vendor specs. Real budgets depend on the specific device, scene complexity, and how many assets are on screen at once; these are conservative single-model ballpark thresholds meant to catch an obviously oversized asset, not to certify a scene as performant. Edit here to tune without touching code.

platforms.label: Meta Quest (standalone)
platforms.notes: Standalone mobile GPU — the most constrained target. Prefer texture atlasing and 1-2 draw calls per model where possible.

platforms.label: iOS/Android (ARKit/ARCore)
platforms.notes: Phone GPUs vary widely; this assumes a mid-range device from the last few years, not the newest flagship.

platforms.label: Apple visionOS
platforms.notes: More headroom than phone AR, but still a headset GPU budget, not a desktop one.

platforms.label: Web (WASM/WebGL2)
platforms.notes: Bounded by the slowest realistic target browser/device, not the developer's own machine.
